Summary Curves with Quantile Bands

Source: R/figure-plots-curves.R
PlotQuantileCurves.Rd

Draws one curve per series over a continuous axis (for example the median across patients of a cumulative distance distribution) with an optional band between lower and upper quantiles, an optional dashed reference line, direct series labels and a corner note written from the data. With facet, draws a grid of small multiples with identical axes and a coloured title above each panel.

Usage

PlotQuantileCurves(
  data,
  x = "x",
  y = "median",
  lower = NULL,
  upper = NULL,
  series = "series",
  series_order = NULL,
  colours = NULL,
  linewidth = 1.4,
  band_alpha = 0.15,
  labels = NULL,
  label_at = NULL,
  label_dx = 3,
  label_size = 5.3,
  reference_x = NULL,
  reference_linewidth = 0.5,
  x_limits = NULL,
  y_limits = NULL,
  x_breaks = NULL,
  y_breaks = NULL,
  x_nbins = 6,
  y_nbins = 9,
  x_label = NULL,
  y_label = NULL,
  tick_size = NULL,
  note = NULL,
  note_xy = c(0.97, 0.04),
  note_hjust = 1,
  note_vjust = 0,
  note_size = 5,
  note_colour = "muted",
  facet = NULL,
  facet_order = NULL,
  facet_ncol = 4,
  facet_gap_mm = c(5, 5),
  facet_data = NULL,
  facet_title = NULL,
  facet_note = NULL,
  facet_group = NULL,
  group_colours = NULL,
  facet_title_size = 5.6,
  facet_note_size = 4.6,
  box_mm = NULL,
  style = ManuscriptStyle()
)

Arguments

data

Tidy data: one row per series (and facet) and x value.

x, y

Columns of the x value and the curve value.

lower, upper

Optional band columns.

series

Series column.

series_order

Drawing order of the series (later on top).

colours

Named colours per series.

linewidth

Curve width in points.

band_alpha

Band opacity.

labels

Optional named direct labels per series.

label_at

x value at which direct labels are placed; the label sits label_dx x units to the right of the curve value there.

label_dx, label_size

Label offset (x units) and size (points).

reference_x

Optional x of a dashed vertical reference line.

reference_linewidth

Its width in points.

x_limits, y_limits

Axis limits (automatic with 5% margins when NULL).

x_breaks, y_breaks

Optional tick positions; by default chosen as by the automatic locator of common figure code with at most x_nbins and y_nbins intervals.

x_nbins, y_nbins

Maximum numbers of tick intervals.

x_label, y_label

Axis titles.

tick_size

Tick label size in points.

note

Optional template (see FormatTemplate()) filled from the first row of data, drawn at note_xy (panel fractions).

note_xy, note_hjust, note_vjust, note_size, note_colour

Note placement and style.

facet

Optional column defining small multiples.

facet_order

Order of the facets (row by row).

facet_ncol

Number of columns.

facet_gap_mm

Gaps between neighbouring panels in millimetres (horizontal, vertical), measured between the data areas.

facet_data

Optional data frame with one row per facet (column facet) used for titles.

facet_title, facet_note

Templates written above each panel: a bold title coloured by facet_group and a smaller muted note to its right.

facet_group

Column of facet_data whose value selects the title colour from group_colours.

group_colours

Named colours per group.

facet_title_size, facet_note_size

Sizes in points.

box_mm

Size of the data area c(width, height) in millimetres, passed by RenderFigure(); used by "auto" tick intervals (see NiceBreaks()).

style

A ManuscriptStyle() object.

Value

A 'ggplot2' object.

Examples

d <- data.frame(series = rep(c("a", "b"), each = 4), x = rep(c(0, 10, 20, 30), 2),
                median = c(0, 40, 70, 90, 0, 20, 45, 70), lower = c(0, 30, 60, 85, 0, 10, 35, 60),
                upper = c(0, 50, 80, 95, 0, 30, 55, 80), n = 5)
PlotQuantileCurves(d, colours = c(a = "#7B2FBE", b = "#3B7DD8"), reference_x = 20,
                   labels = c(a = "Series a", b = "Series b"), label_at = 10,
                   note = "Median and IQR\nn = {n|d} units")
